scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Accused of demanding a bribe, can a public servant stop the case for want of approval under Section Seventeen A?
scenes.shown: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Accused of demanding a bribe, can a public servant stop the case for want of approval under Section 17A?

scenes.dialogue: On sixteenth October, twenty twenty six, the Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice S V N Bhatti and Honourable Justice N V Anjaria ruled.
scenes.shown: On 16 October 2026, the Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice S.V.N. Bhatti and Honourable Justice N.V. Anjaria ruled.

scenes.dialogue: Tejaram, a police constable, was accused by a colleague of demanding one and a half lakh rupees, in the name of the Superintendent of Police.
scenes.shown: Tejaram, a police constable, was accused by a colleague of demanding ₹1.5 lakh, in the name of the Superintendent of Police.

scenes.dialogue: An F I R came in twenty twenty one. After sanction, a charge under Section Seven was framed in twenty twenty four, and the High Court upheld it.
scenes.shown: An FIR came in 2021. After sanction, a charge under Section 7 was framed in 2024, and the High Court upheld it.

scenes.dialogue: His plea: Section Seventeen A of the Prevention of Corruption Act needs prior approval to investigate a public servant's official acts. None was taken.
scenes.shown: His plea: Section 17A of the Prevention of Corruption Act needs prior approval to investigate a public servant's official acts. None was taken.

scenes.dialogue: The Court read it closely: approval is needed only where the offence relates to a recommendation made, or a decision taken, in official duty.
A bribe demand is neither: a pure criminal act, unconnected to official functions. Earlier rulings, Santosh Karnani and Anil Daima, agree.
The pending larger bench reference on Section Seventeen A had no bearing. And the Section Nineteen sanction, taken before cognizance, was no fatal defect.
scenes.shown: The pending larger-bench reference on Section 17A had no bearing. And the Section 19 sanction, taken before cognizance, was no fatal defect.

scenes.dialogue: The appeal was dismissed; the trial goes on. Section Seventeen A needs a link to an official decision or recommendation, and a bribe demand has none.
scenes.shown: The appeal was dismissed; the trial goes on. Section 17A needs a link to an official decision or recommendation, and a bribe demand has none.
